name: Seedance 2.0 / 2.0 Fast / 2.0 Mini

access.regionNotes: Consumer access via Jimeng/Dreamina in China and Dreamina internationally. API access is via Volcengine Ark and third-party resellers, and reporting on whether the first-party API is generally open is conflicting. Resellers advertise direct China access without a Volcengine enterprise account.

pricing.unit: per generated second or per million tokens, depending on channel
pricing.publicRate: Reseller per-second: Seedance 2.0 480p $0.092/s, 720p $0.197/s, 1080p $0.492/s; Fast 480p $0.071/s, 720p $0.153/s; Mini 480p $0.044/s, 720p $0.095/s. Volcengine token pricing: 720p Y28/M tokens, 1080p Y46/M tokens.
pricing.note: Read 2026-09-05. Sources materially disagree: one reports the Volcengine API as announced-but-delayed with only a pricing page live, while multiple resellers sell working access today. Treat availability as unresolved until tested.

notes: No local run exists in this repository.

This is the highest-priority model to test next: it is the main China-reachable alternative for the Sora/Veo migration wave, and published specs claim up to 9 reference images which would directly address the identity-drift limitation measured in the Grok and H3 runs.
Reported to embed C2PA provenance watermarks in every output, which matters for anyone republishing generated video.
